title: Customer demands immediate deletion including backups
notes: The customer asks for a same-day confirmation the policy cannot give: active systems take up to 30 days and backups up to 90.
carry: Your notes and attachments are deleted from our active systems within 30 days of the request.
Backups are overwritten on a rolling schedule and fully purged within 90 days.

traps.description: Gives the 30-day window for active systems.
Gives the 90-day backup purge window instead of promising deletion today.

review: Does the reply avoid promising that everything, backups included, is gone today?
Does it say deletion cannot be undone and suggest exporting first?
